move.subject: SH-220: competitive award and delivery requirement
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you. We are selecting one supplier for 6,000 shafts annually over 24 months from two bidders. Your standard 45-day lead time cannot meet our maximum of 42 days; our production requirement is 35 days.
Please consider either €13.91/unit, payment 45 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW; or €14.41/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP. The second package offers faster cash collection in exchange for delivered pricing. Please confirm which package you can support for the full award and whether you can commit to 35-day delivery.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We can commit to your requested 35-day lead time and DAP delivery; however, these expedited and delivered terms necessitate a unit price of €16.70. We welcome the 14-day payment terms, which we have fully factored into this calculation. 

Our Angebot is a price of €16.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP. It stays valid for 30 days.

To help us align our production planning, could you please provide the binding delivery schedules for the 6,000 annual units? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: SH-220: volume confirmation and revised proposal
move.body:
Hallo Frau Aigner,
Thank you for the substantial move and for confirming DAP and 35-day delivery. The award covers 6,000 shafts per year for 24 months; that is the volume basis we can commit to for the selected supplier.
My target is a commercial award target, not a claim about your manufacturing costs; I do not have a verified cost breakdown to send you. In return for your move, I can raise our proposal to €15.13/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP, retaining the faster payment you value.
Can you approve this package against the full-volume award?
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.subject: SH-220: planning basis and competitive revision
move.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,
Thank you for confirming 35-day delivery. The selected supplier receives 6,000 units annually for 24 months; I cannot commit to a higher volume, and exact release dates must be aligned with production rather than invented now.
The competing SH-220 offer is €16.10/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP (offer:DEMO-J1-1), so your €16.70 package is not competitive.
My earlier figure is a commercial negotiation target, not a verified manufacturing-cost estimate. Our proposal remains €14.41/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, DAP; alternatively, to remove delivery logistics from your scope, €13.82/unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 35 days, EXW. Please review the full-volume award and fast-payment benefit with your approver and return your best achievable package.
Best regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for confirming the annual volume and providing insight into the competitive situation. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €16.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. 

Alternatively, we have recalculated our costs for the DAP delivery with 14-day payment terms and can offer a revised price of €16.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

While we note the competing offer, this is the best price we can provide to guarantee the reliable 35-day lead time and high quality you require. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
